record.question: He is on the bus. Identify the parts of speech of the underlined word 'on'.
record.explanation: Answer B: preposition. On governs the noun phrase “the bus”; it is a preposition (B). Independent check: “On” relates the bus to the passenger’s location/position and is a preposition. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/prepositions. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
